scripts.dev: npm run build:deps && npm run build:electron && concurrently -k -n renderer,tsc,electron "npm run dev:renderer" "npm run dev:electron:watch" "npm run dev:electron:start"
scripts.dev:electron: npm run build:electron && npm run dev:electron:start
scripts.dev:electron:start: wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5187 dist-electron/main/index.js && cross-env NODE_ENV=development ROBBOT_RENDERER_DEV_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5187 nodemon --delay 750ms --watch dist-electron --ext js,json --exec "electron ."
scripts.build:deps: pnpm --filter @robbot/core build && pnpm --filter @robbot/dsh-adapter build && node scripts/sync-workspace-deps.mjs
scripts.build: npm run build:deps && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.package: npm run build && node scripts/forge-runtime-package.mjs package
scripts.make: npm run build && node scripts/forge-runtime-package.mjs make
scripts.make:mac: npm run build && node scripts/forge-runtime-package.mjs make --platform darwin --arch arm64
scripts.make:win: node scripts/verify-target.mjs win32 x64 && npm run installer:assets && npm run dsh:setup && npm run build && node scripts/forge-runtime-package.mjs make --platform win32 --arch x64
scripts.make:win:nsis: node scripts/verify-target.mjs win32 x64 && npm run installer:assets && npm run dsh:setup && npm run build && node scripts/forge-runtime-package.mjs package --platform win32 --arch x64 && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --prepackaged out/Robbot-win32-x64 --config electron-builder.nsis.yml
scripts.publish:win: node scripts/verify-target.mjs win32 x64 && npm run installer:assets && npm run dsh:setup && npm run build && node scripts/forge-runtime-package.mjs publish --platform win32 --arch x64
scripts.publish: npm run build && node scripts/forge-runtime-package.mjs publish
